event_summary: A person in a blue shirt approaches an outdoor fire pit with large flames and positions long wood pieces across and into the pit.
raw_event_description: The video begins with a metal fire ring on an ash-covered patch of ground, with large orange flames extending upward and leftward from wood in and around the ring. A flat rectangular board lies diagonally on the right side near the flames, and two chairs stand behind the pit. A person wearing a bright blue shirt enters from the left foreground carrying a long dark cylindrical log, steps toward the pit, and holds the log across the fire area. The person then stands close to the pit, bends forward, and manipulates a dark stick or log into the ring area while the flames and smoke continue changing shape.

reasons: Large flames, the fire ring, wood pieces, ash-covered ground, nearby board, chairs, and surrounding yard are visible from the first frame.
The main flame activity is already underway at the start.
